name: GRX crankset
weight_description: Manufacturer average 806 g for the exact FC-RX600-11 reference with 170 mm arms and 46/30T chainrings; the 2020 table explicitly excludes the bottom bracket. Other arm lengths and ring options do not inherit this mass.

technical_document.title: Shimano 2020 TSS manual, PDF/printed page 369: GRX front derailleurs: RX810-F / RX400-F brazed-on 96 g; crank averages explicitly 170 mm without bottom bracket; flat-mount two-piston calipers
